tier_reason: First-party 2016 blog post (read from its source in the libmir/blog repo) gives per-size single-threaded GFLOPS for Mir GLAS 0.18.0, OpenBLAS 0.2.18, Eigen 3.3-rc1, MKL 2017.0.098 and Accelerate on an i7-4770HQ, but the LDC version and build flags are not stated and the linked benchmark source (libmir/mir benchmarks/glas/gemm_report.d) now returns 404, so C.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Blog conclusion: 'Mir GLAS is significantly faster than OpenBLAS and Apple Accelerate for virtually all benchmarks and parameters, two times faster than Eigen and Apple Accelerate for complex matrix multiplication. Mir GLAS average performance equals to Intel MKL.' From the chart data (_includes/bench_charts_1.html, GFLOPS for m=n=k from 10 to 2000, single thread), median Mir/OpenBLAS ratios are 1.15x sgemm, 1.13x dgemm, 1.12x cgemm, 1.10x zgemm, with Mir ahead at 22-23 of 23 sizes; at N=2000 sgemm 85.9 vs 75.8 GFLOPS (1.13x) and dgemm 42.0 vs 40.3 (1.04x). Versus Eigen the medians are 1.06-1.07x for real and 1.91-1.96x for complex types; versus Accelerate 1.12x real and 3.3x complex; versus MKL about 1.00-1.01x (MKL slightly ahead on dgemm at N>=500, 0.97x median). All ratios derived from page data.
corrections.compiler_and_flags: LDC (version not stated in the post; README requires LDC >= 1.1.0 beta 6); GLAS build flags not stated in the post (README manual build uses dub --build=target-native --compiler=ldmd2); Eigen built with CMake Release -DEIGEN_TEST_AVX=ON -DEIGEN_TEST_FMA=ON; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
corrections.hardware: 2.2 GHz Core i7 (i7-4770HQ, Haswell), 6 MB L3, 16 GB DDR3L-1600, MacBookPro11,2, OS X 10.11.6, single thread
corrections.caveats: Numbers are first-party, from 2016, single-threaded only (GLAS has no multithreading), against OpenBLAS 0.2.18 and Eigen 3.3-rc1 on one Haswell laptop. The linked benchmark source is gone (404), and the LDC version and flags are not stated. Claim likely not reproducible with current compilers: the README points to open issue #18 ('2 x slower with LLVM 4.X - 5.X', opened by the author 2017-03-30), which reports the GEMM micro-kernel running about twice as slow when built with LLVM 4.0 than with LLVM 3.9.1. GitHub issue #20 ('[AMD] mir-glas is slower than OpenBLAS for DGEMM', 2017-04-01, no maintainer reply) reports it slower than OpenBLAS on an AMD machine. Only GEMM, SYMM, HEMM and Level 1 are implemented. Last real code commits are from 2018, README-only edit in 2022. The rendered post is at blog.mir.dlang.io (blocked from this container); its Jekyll source and chart data are in github.com/libmir/blog.

notes: The blog page itself was blocked, but its source and chart data in the libmir/blog repo were read first-hand, replacing the search-snippet-based claim; quoted conclusions and hardware match the record. Boost license (LICENSE_1_0.txt), 102 stars, last commit 2022-08-19 confirmed (abandoned).
